description: IPv4 subnet planner (VLSM) — Carve an IPv4 block into right-sized subnets. base= CIDR plus hosts= as a comma list of name:hosts (sales:200), name:/prefix (dmz:/28), bare counts (120,60) or N*hosts / N*/prefix (wan:4*/30). Optional growth= percent headroom per subnet, p2p31=true to size 2-host links as /31. Allocates largest-first so every subnet is aligned with no gaps, and returns network, mask, wildcard, first/last host, broadcast, usable vs requested hosts, suggested gateway, the leftover free blocks as CIDRs, and the smallest base that fits when it does not. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_subnet_plan
